---
title: "TAOOH — first- versus second-order Markov model"
subtitle: "PSIS-LOO comparison per imputation"
format: html
---

- Observation-level PSIS-LOO; `rmsb` lacks the marginal likelihood for leave-one-patient-out
- Substantial: ELPD difference (second minus first order) above twice its SE

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(rms)
library(rmsb)
library(loo)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)

second_order_model_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "04-taooh", "03-second-order-markov", "results", "models"
)
results_dir <- here("analysis", "04-taooh", "04-first-order-markov", "results")
first_order_model_dir <- here(results_dir, "models")
loo_dir <- here(results_dir, "loo")
dir.create(loo_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Comparison per imputation

```{r}
#| label: compare-markov-order
#| include: false

model_comparison <- indices |>
  map(\(index) {
    second_order <- readRDS(
      here(second_order_model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
    )
    first_order <- readRDS(
      here(first_order_model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
    )

    if (
      !isTRUE(second_order$pppo == 0L) || !is.null(second_order$cppo) ||
        !isTRUE(first_order$pppo == 0L) || !is.null(first_order$cppo)
    ) {
      stop("LOO comparison requires full proportional odds in both models.")
    }

    second_terms <- attr(terms(formula(second_order)), "term.labels")
    first_terms <- attr(terms(formula(first_order)), "term.labels")
    if (
      !setequal(
        setdiff(second_terms, first_terms),
        c("ypprev", "week %ia% ypprev")
      ) ||
        length(setdiff(first_terms, second_terms)) > 0L
    ) {
      stop(
        "The compared models differ by terms other than the second-order ",
        "state and its interaction with week."
      )
    }

    # PSIS-LOO is expensive, so each LOO object is saved and reused.
    second_order_loo_path <- here(
      loo_dir,
      sprintf("second-order-loo-%02d.rds", index)
    )
    if (!file.exists(second_order_loo_path)) {
      saveRDS(
        stanGet(second_order)$loo(),
        second_order_loo_path,
        compress = "xz"
      )
    }
    second_order_loo <- readRDS(second_order_loo_path)

    first_order_loo_path <- here(
      loo_dir,
      sprintf("first-order-loo-%02d.rds", index)
    )
    if (!file.exists(first_order_loo_path)) {
      saveRDS(
        stanGet(first_order)$loo(),
        first_order_loo_path,
        compress = "xz"
      )
    }
    first_order_loo <- readRDS(first_order_loo_path)

    first_pointwise <- first_order_loo$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"]
    second_pointwise <- second_order_loo$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"]
    stopifnot(
      "The two LOO objects do not contain the same number of observations." =
        length(first_pointwise) == length(second_pointwise)
    )

    # Stacking weights depend only on the pointwise ELPD. They are computed
    # from it directly (as rmsb::compareBmods() would via
    # loo::loo_model_weights()), because a model refitted with more iterations
    # has more posterior draws and loo_model_weights() requires equal draws.
    stacking_weights <- set_names(
      as.numeric(stacking_weights(cbind(first_pointwise, second_pointwise))),
      c("first_order", "second_order")
    )

    loo_comparison <- loo_compare(list(
      first_order = first_order_loo,
      second_order = second_order_loo
    ))
    # loo_compare() returns a data frame with a model column.
    write_parquet(
      as.data.frame(loo_comparison),
      here(loo_dir, sprintf("loo-compare-%02d.parquet", index)),
      compression = "zstd"
    )

    pointwise_difference <- second_pointwise - first_pointwise
    delta_elpd <- sum(pointwise_difference)
    se_delta_elpd <- sqrt(
      length(pointwise_difference) * var(pointwise_difference)
    )

    tibble(
      imputation = index,
      n_observations = length(pointwise_difference),
      elpd_loo_first_order = first_order_loo$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"],
      se_elpd_loo_first_order = first_order_loo$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"],
      elpd_loo_second_order = second_order_loo$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"],
      se_elpd_loo_second_order = second_order_loo$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"],
      delta_elpd_second_minus_first = delta_elpd,
      se_delta_elpd = se_delta_elpd,
      delta_elpd_over_se = delta_elpd / se_delta_elpd,
      first_order_stacking_weight = unname(stacking_weights[["first_order"]]),
      second_order_stacking_weight = unname(stacking_weights[["second_order"]]),
      max_pareto_k_first_order = max(pareto_k_values(first_order_loo)),
      max_pareto_k_second_order = max(pareto_k_values(second_order_loo)),
      substantial_second_order_improvement = delta_elpd > 2 * se_delta_elpd,
      substantial_first_order_improvement = delta_elpd < -2 * se_delta_elpd
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

write_parquet(
  model_comparison,
  here(results_dir, "loo-model-comparison.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## Interpretation across imputations

```{r}
#| label: interpret-comparison
#| include: false

n_imputations <- length(indices)
n_substantial_second <- sum(
  model_comparison$substantial_second_order_improvement
)
n_substantial_first <- sum(
  model_comparison$substantial_first_order_improvement
)
n_favor_second <- sum(model_comparison$delta_elpd_second_minus_first > 0)
pareto_warning <- any(
  model_comparison$max_pareto_k_first_order > 0.7 |
    model_comparison$max_pareto_k_second_order > 0.7
)

interpretation <- case_when(
  n_substantial_second == n_imputations ~ paste0(
    "The second-order model has a substantial predictive-fit advantage in ",
    "all completed datasets included in this run."
  ),
  n_substantial_second >= ceiling(n_imputations / 2) ~ paste0(
    "The second-order model has a substantial predictive-fit advantage in ",
    n_substantial_second,
    " of ", n_imputations,
    " completed datasets, with positive ELPD differences in ",
    n_favor_second,
    " of ", n_imputations,
    ". The advantage is directionally consistent but not uniform."
  ),
  n_substantial_first >= ceiling(n_imputations / 2) ~ paste0(
    "The first-order model has a substantial predictive-fit advantage in ",
    n_substantial_first,
    " of ", n_imputations, " completed datasets."
  ),
  TRUE ~ paste0(
    "The comparison does not show a consistent substantial predictive-fit ",
    "advantage for either Markov order. The second-order ELPD is higher in ",
    n_favor_second,
    " of ", n_imputations, " completed datasets."
  )
)

if (pareto_warning) {
  interpretation <- paste0(
    interpretation,
    " At least one fit has a Pareto-k value above 0.7, so the affected ",
    "PSIS-LOO comparison requires caution."
  )
}

interpretation_result <- tibble(
  imputations = n_imputations,
  substantial_second_order = n_substantial_second,
  substantial_first_order = n_substantial_first,
  favor_second_order = n_favor_second,
  pareto_k_warning = pareto_warning,
  interpretation = interpretation
)

write_parquet(
  interpretation_result,
  here(results_dir, "loo-interpretation.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-taooh-markov-order-comparison
#| tbl-cap: "PSIS-LOO comparison of first- and second-order TAOOH models"
#| echo: false

model_comparison |>
  select(
    imputation,
    delta_elpd_second_minus_first,
    se_delta_elpd,
    first_order_stacking_weight,
    second_order_stacking_weight,
    max_pareto_k_first_order,
    max_pareto_k_second_order
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: interpret-taooh-markov-order-comparison
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

cat(interpretation)
```
